description: This file defines the PeekabooBridgeHostCoordinator class responsible for managing the lifecycle of a PeekabooBridge host, including setup, starting, stopping, and maintaining legacy socket symlinks. It also offers a singleton shared instance and relies on external security and file system services. Additionally, it contains a private class providing services used by the host.

classes.name: PeekabooBridgeHostCoordinator
classes.description: Manages the setup and lifecycle of the Peekaboo bridge host, including socket path management, legacy symlinks, and security info.

classes.name: OpenClawPeekabooBridgeServices
classes.description: Provides various permission, UI automation, window, application, menu, dock, dialog, and snapshot services for the bridge.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the PeekabooBridge host as per the argument.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the host if it is running and resets related properties.

methods.name: startIfNeeded
methods.description: Initializes and starts the PeekabooBridge host if it is not already running.

methods.name: ensureLegacySocketSymlinks
methods.description: Ensures all legacy socket symlinks are correctly established.

methods.name: ensureLegacySocketSymlink
methods.description: Creates or updates a symbolic link for a legacy socket path.

methods.name: currentTeamID
methods.description: Fetches the current team's ID via security framework.
